name: Resonance Musical
description: Dissonateur créant des interférences sonores désorientantes empêchant l'ennemi de communiquer efficacement sur le champ de bataille.

subject.archetype: Cybernetic Sound Combat Specialist - Smooth faceless humanoid android of the Synthetic Choir faction, specialized in dissonant warfare and acoustic interference, no facial features whatsoever, sleek metallic body with integrated ceremonial elements

loadout.armor_outfit: Layered synthetic fiber monk robes interwoven with braided data cables forming the lower garment, geometric polished steel and aged white ceramic plates covering torso and limbs in monastic style, holographic golden runic symbols orbiting the body in slow rotation, chest piece bearing mandala-inspired circuitry patterns, prayer bead chapelet made of interconnected micro-hard drives hanging from belt
loadout.arsenal: Long pilgrim's staff crowned with resonating crystal formations that emit dissonant frequencies, the staff crackling with golden electrical arcs along its length, secondary wrist-mounted acoustic emitter devices projecting binary equation sequences during combat

attitude.behavior: Combat stance with weapon raised overhead ready to strike, body coiled in explosive potential, weight shifted to rear leg, arms positioned to channel maximum resonance force, every servo and joint locked in predatory readiness, surrounding air visibly rippling and distorting from emitted frequencies, enemy positions being torn apart by sonic shockwaves
attitude.emotion: Imperturbable machine serenity masking devastating purpose, featureless smooth faceplate conveying absolute focus, internal processing dedicated entirely to calculating harmonic frequencies that will shatter enemy communications and crystalline structures

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic dramatic rim lighting with golden holographic glow emanating from runic elements and staff, secondary cold ambient light from shattered crystal formations, volumetric fog from suspended crystal dust, visible sound waves rendered as rippling distortion rings
color_and_light.mood: Solemn yet devastating, sacred violence, hypnotic destruction through harmonic resonance

camera.angle: Low angle slightly dutch, looking up at the android figure silhouetted against the chaos of the crumbling amphitheater, emphasizing the imposing presence and raised weapon

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater transformed into a battlefield, massive crystal formations erupting from floors and walls, ceiling structures cracked and resonating with visible harmonic stress, ancient stone seating destroyed by repeated sonic shockwaves, jagged crystal shards raining from above, debris suspended mid-air by persistent vibration frequencies, broken mandala patterns visible in the destroyed floor architecture
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Multiple concentric shockwave rings expanding outward from combatant position tearing through enemy positions, crystal formations exploding into razor-sharp fragments, entire environment visibly vibrating with distortion ripples in the air, crystal dust suspended in volumetric fog, enemies scattered and disoriented by dissonant frequencies, golden energy trails following staff movements, cracked ceiling sections threatening to collapse
